verse.verse_2: There is about its happening no lie.
verse.verse_4: This will happen when the earth is shaken, shaken
verse.verse_5: And the mountains are crumbled, crumbled.
verse.verse_6: So that they become dust seattered.
verse.verse_8: Those on the right hand; how happy shall those on the right hand be!
verse.verse_9: And those on the left hand; how miserable shall those on the left hand be!
verse.verse_10: And the preceders are the pre-ceders.
verse.verse_11: Those! they shall be the brought nigh,
verse.verse_14: And a few from the later generations.
verse.verse_15: On couches in wrought with gold.
verse.verse_17: There shall go round Unto them youths ever-young.
verse.verse_18: With goblets and ewers and a cup of limpid drink.
verse.verse_19: Whereby there shall be neither headiness nor will they be inebriated.
verse.verse_20: And with fruit from that which they choose.
verse.verse_21: And with flesh of fowls from that Which they desire.
verse.verse_22: And there will be fair ones large eyed.
verse.verse_24: A recompense for that which they have been working.
verse.verse_25: Therein they hear no vain or sinful discourse.
verse.verse_26: Nought but the saying: peace! peace!
verse.verse_27: And the fellows on the right hand; how be happy shall the fellows on the right hand be!
verse.verse_35: Verily We! We have created those maidens by a creation.
verse.verse_38: For the fellows on the right hand.
verse.verse_40: And a multitude from the later generations.
verse.verse_41: And the fellows on the left hand; how miserable Shall the fellows on the left hand be!
verse.verse_42: Amidst scorching wind and scalding water.
verse.verse_43: And the shade of black smoke.
verse.verse_45: Verily they have been heretofore affluent.
verse.verse_46: And they have been persisting in the heinous offence.
verse.verse_47: And they were wont to say: when we have died and become dust and bones, shall we, then, verily be raised?
verse.verse_48: We and our fathers of old?
verse.verse_49: Say thou: verily the ancients and those of later generations:
verse.verse_50: Are going to be assembled on the appointed time of a Day Known.
verse.verse_51: Then verily ye, O ye erring, denying people.
verse.verse_52: Shall surely eat of the tree of Az-Zqqum.
verse.verse_53: And shall fill therewith your bellies.
verse.verse_54: And shall be drinkers thereon of boiling water.
verse.verse_55: Drinkers even as the drinking of thirsty camels.
verse.verse_56: This shall be their entertainment on the Day of Requital.
verse.verse_57: We! it is We Who created you: wherefore confess ye not?
verse.verse_59: Create him ye, or are We the Creator?
verse.verse_60: We! it is We Who have decreed death Unto you all. And We are not to be outrun.
verse.verse_61: That We may substitute others like Unto you and produce you into that which ye know not.
verse.verse_62: And assuredly ye have fully known the first Production Wherefore heed ye not?
verse.verse_64: Cause it ye to grow, or are We the Grower?
verse.verse_65: If We willed, surely We would make it chaff, so that ye would be left wondering.
verse.verse_68: Behold! - the water which ye drink:
verse.verse_69: Send it down ye from the raincloud, or are We the Sender down?
verse.verse_70: If We willed, surely We would make it brackish. Wherefore give ye not thanks?
verse.verse_71: Behold! - the fire which ye strike out:
verse.verse_72: Produce ye the tree thereof, or are We the Producer?
verse.verse_73: We! it is We Who made it a reminder and a provision Unto the campers.
verse.verse_74: Wherefore hallow thou the name of thy Lord, the Mighty.
verse.verse_75: I swear by the setting of the stars -
verse.verse_76: And verily that is a mighty oath, if ye but knew!
verse.verse_77: That it is a Recitation honourable.
verse.verse_79: Which none can touch except the purified.
verse.verse_80: It is a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
verse.verse_81: Is it this discourse that ye hold lightly?
verse.verse_82: And make it your provision that ye should belie it?
verse.verse_83: Wherefore then - when the soul cometh up to the wind-pipe -
verse.verse_84: And ye are then looking on.
verse.verse_85: And We are nigher Unto him than ye are, but ye behold not-
verse.verse_86: Wherefore then, if ye are not to be requited
verse.verse_87: Cause ye it not to return, if ye say sooth?
verse.verse_88: Then if he be of the broughtnigh.
verse.verse_89: For him shall be comfort, and fragrance and a Garden of Delight.
verse.verse_90: And if he be of the fellows on the right hand,
verse.verse_91: Then: peace Unto thee, for thou art of those on the right hand.
verse.verse_92: And if he be of the beliers, the erring,
verse.verse_93: Then an entertainment of boiling water.
verse.verse_95: Verily this! this is the very truth.
verse.verse_96: Wherefore hallow thou the name of thy Lord, the Mighty!
